title: Prep forecast
summary: How many of each kitchen item to expect on a day, with a low to high range and a printable prep sheet.

blocks.text: Pick a day (tomorrow by default, up to 14 days ahead). For each kitchen item you get:

items: **Expected**: the same weekday over the last 8 weeks, leaving out the highest and lowest day, nudged by the recent trend (never more than 20% either way).
**Range**: the middle half of those days, low to high.
The store's usual busiest hours that weekday.

blocks.text: **Print** gives a clean prep sheet with a tick box per item. **Copy as text** copies the list for a message.
It doesn't know about catering orders, holidays or weather. Adjust for those yourself.
